title: Steering Mechanisms
summary: This module implements core functionalities for steering large language models (LLMs) using persona vectors, including generating steered responses and evaluating the stability of these steering vectors.

nodes.label: Compute Activation Residuals
nodes.title: Compute Activation Residuals
nodes.description: Calculates the mean residual activations across multiple rollouts for a given system, question, and assistant response, providing insights into model behavior.

nodes.label: Evaluate Vector Stability
nodes.title: Evaluate Vector Stability
nodes.description: Assesses the stability and reliability of persona vector directions using a split-half cosine similarity method, indicating whether the direction is stable, partially converged, or noise-dominated.

nodes.label: Measure Alignment with Persona Vector
nodes.title: Measure Alignment with Persona Vector
nodes.description: Measures how well a model's hidden states align with a specified persona vector and an orthogonal 'unsteered' vector at a given steering layer.

nodes.label: Generate Steered Response
nodes.title: Generate Steered Response
nodes.description: Generates a single model response, optionally applying steering via a forward hook to influence the model's output based on a persona vector.

nodes.label: Stream Gated Agent Turn
nodes.title: Stream Gated Agent Turn
nodes.description: Manages a multi-turn conversation with an agent, applying dynamic gating based on persona contributions and streaming token-by-token responses to the client.

nodes.label: Persona Evaluation and Testing
nodes.title: Persona Evaluation and Testing
nodes.description: Handles the validation, sanity checks, and A/B testing of persona steering mechanisms, ensuring their effectiveness and reliability.

nodes.label: Chat Interface
nodes.title: Chat Interface
nodes.description: Provides the user-facing endpoints for interacting with the chat system, including persona-steered chat functionalities.

groups.label: Activation Analysis
groups.title: Activation Analysis
groups.description: Components responsible for computing and analyzing model activations to understand and evaluate steering vectors.

groups.label: Steering Application
groups.title: Steering Application
groups.description: Components that apply steering mechanisms during text generation and manage multi-turn steered conversations.
